description: This PHP source file defines the GDPR email controller class for the OpenCart admin system. It handles GDPR-related email notifications like export, approval, denial, and removal, loading necessary models and templates to generate email content dynamically based on GDPR info.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for handling GDPR email communication in the admin area, with methods for exporting, approving, denying, and removing GDPR data requests and sending corresponding emails.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that determines which GDPR email operation to perform based on provided arguments, calling specific methods for export, approve, remove, or deny actions.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Generates and schedules an email containing user GDPR data export information, including customer details, addresses, order history, and IPs.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Generates and schedules an email notifying user GDPR data approval, with relevant customer details and a specific message.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Generates and schedules an email informing the user that their GDPR data request was denied, including contact information.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Generates and schedules an email to notify the user their GDPR data has been removed, including customer details and contact info.
